question: What engineering plans and clearances are mandatory when applying for a Demolition Permit from OCBO?
answer:
To apply for a Demolition Permit from OCBO, the following engineering plans and clearances are mandatory:

1. Submit the plans and documents [S1, S2].
2. The plans and documents should include an Order of Payment (OP) and Official Receipt (OR) [S1, S2].
3. The plans and documents are to be forwarded to the PED Chief for final recommendation [S1, S2].
4. The plans and documents are then forwarded to the Building Official (BO) for signing and approval [S1, S2].
5. The Demolition Permit number is stamped on the plans and documents [S1].
6. The approved plans and documents are ready for claiming [S2].

[S1] OCBD Pages from CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-2.pdf | printed page 558 | chunk DEV120-OCBO-PDF0070-C001
[S2] OCBD Pages from CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-2.pdf | printed page 558 | chunk DEV120-OCBO-PDF0070-C002

ground_truth: A Demolition Permit requires a demolition form, 3 sets of civil/architectural plans signed and sealed by a civil engineer/architect, vicinity sketch plan by a geodetic engineer, bill of materials, owner ID, and DPWH clearance if along a national highway.
